paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Headline result: R2-parameter (AGB/HB ratio) globular-cluster stellar-cooling bound g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 = 4.7e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% CL. This is the most conservative (semiconvection, SC) scheme value g10=0.47, adopted by the authors as their final constraint (abstract and Sec 3.2; the purple 'R2' region in Fig.1). The pink 'R2 (asteroseismology)' bound g_agamma < 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 is shown only for comparison and NOT adopted as the main result. Flat limit; rules out ALP masses between O(1e-6) and O(1) eV (Sec 3.2, text), rendered as two points. Not a dark-matter search, so density-independent (dm_density null).
